purpose: Image inspection notes, not user visual approval.

context_differences: Actual: synthetic Bharat owner on 15 October 2026, with 60 players and six batches. Reference: Coach Rahul at Riverside on 20 October with example totals.
No session is scheduled on the capture day. The hero truthfully shows the next confirmed 20 October session. October has no reports; 120 approved historical reports remain separate.
visual_differences: The navy sidebar, football hero, adjacent schedule, four metrics and supporting card grid follow the reference composition. The hero preserves matching football imagery.
Actual support text and icons are smaller and lighter. Lower cards occupy more vertical space; the complete actual page is 1114 px high versus the 1024 px reference.
The academy uses a shield fallback and the development card uses a focus icon because no academy crest or child portrait was supplied. The reference crest, portrait and closing quote are absent.
limitations: The empty Today schedule and October chart differ in density from the populated reference. They are actual data states, not fabricated example activity.

limitations: The added real Trial enrolment controls are part of the later functional scope. Missing portraits and player attributes limit a like-for-like visual comparison.

The selected Under-8 session uses its actual coach, ten-player roster, Excelsior location, shared focus and preparation.
visual_differences: The week grid, filter row and right session panel follow the reference structure. Actual view controls sit at the right of the date navigation rather than immediately beside it.
The actual grid has hourly labels and runs to 9 PM. Consecutive one-hour events are short cards with clipped secondary text; the reference uses larger event blocks and two-hour labels.
Session details use smaller headings and support text, with the primary action and tabs lower in the panel. The actual selected day header lacks the reference pale-green date highlight.
limitations: Only training events exist in the fixture. Other event colours and the denser reference schedule cannot be compared from this state.

limitations: Photographic drill thumbnails are not matched. Mobile native selects can abbreviate long option text; complete accessible labels and native option lists remain available.
